column4: Plan amendment 2 + calibration sweep results: Korean calibration FAILED (untuned port 66.3%/80.8pp/5.32x; best grid point 91.6%/37.1pp/1.59x; targets 76.5/32.1/3.4, no grid point reaches them); policy arms frozen on canonical 420 params per task brief; box cgroup quota is 10 CPUs not 80, so workers capped at 8 nice-n-10 (measured 56-worker oversubscription slower)

Engine fixes for review items 3A-3C: (A) persistent Korean G9 placement consequence (elite9 flag: upper-secondary learning boost + G12 contest input boost, g9_consequence switch; V1 on, V3 legacy off) instead of a phantom prize; (B) expected top-K admission probability now a logistic in log effective input fitted each gate year by vectorised Gumbel-max Monte Carlo of the gate's own Plackett-Luce ranking, used by both values() and contest effort choice (replaces 1-exp(-lambda x^r)); (C) applicant/seat/ratio/realised-admission and expected-vs-realised decile/effort-quintile diagnostics recorded per gate in the scored window, for seat-denominator reporting. Also: lumpy contest purchase margin (420-generation 0.25), per-gate G9 wage channel (default 0), canonical 420 runner with V1/V2/V3 variants, 30 matched seeds, N_WORKERS<=56.

Plan amendment 1 (pre-sweep): untuned 420 port misses Korean training moments; declare widened 6x3 calibration grid, selection rule and unchanged held-out moments; freeze G9 canonical (set_voc=True) and V3 phantom variant definition; record contest-only vs general-tutoring alternative

Model revision plan (pre-registered): canonical = restored 420 spec ported to patched engine; G9 placement fix + V2/V3 variants; Gumbel-MC-calibrated expected top-K probability; seat accounting; declared Korean calibration procedure with held-out moments; rerun arm list and CF4-failure retention; box CPU cap 56/nice-10
